mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Dragged Away</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been struck by Nautilus' anchor and cannot move.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Depth Charge</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been struck by Nautilus and has been knocked into the air and stunned.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Grounded</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is immune to Nautilus' Staggering Blow for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus' basic attacks deal bonus physical damage and immoblize his targets. This effect cannot happen more than once every few seconds on the same target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals @BonusDamage@ bonus physical damage and Roots them for @RootDuration@ seconds.

This effect has a @PerTargetCD@ second cooldown.

mBuff.mDescription:
Depth Charge TargetThis unit has been targetted by Nautilus' Depth Charge ability and is being chased by explosions.

Staying away from this unit would probably be a good idea.Source: @SourceName@

<titleLeft>Wrath</titleLeft><mainText>Nautilus is shielded from incoming damage and his attacks apply a damage over time effect to nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Staggering Blow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been hit by Nautilus' staggering blow and cannot move for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Splishy Splashy</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's movement speed is reduced but will gradually return to normal.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Pain of Wrath</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking damage over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus slams the ground, causing the earth to explode around him in a set of three explosions. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus slams the ground, creating three explosions that each deal <magicDamage>@DamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> enemies by @SlowPercent*100@% decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds. A unit can be hit by more than one explosion, but they take <magicDamage>@DamageHalvedTooltip@ damage</magicDamage> from additional explosions.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits a champion, he drags both himself and the opponent close together. If it hits terrain, Nautilus instead pulls himself to the anchor and the cooldown of Dredge Line is reduced.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing @QDamageCalc@ magic damage and Stunning them briefly.

Hitting terrain instead Pulls Nautilus forward and reduces this ability's cooldown by @TerrainCDR*100@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus fires a shockwave that chases an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>@PrimaryTargetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Knocking Up</status> and <status>Stunning</status> them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also <status>Knocked Up</status>, <status>Stunned</status> and take <magicDamage>@SecondaryTargetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield.  While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Nautilus surrounds himself with dark energies, granting him @ShieldCalc@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

While the Shield persists, Nautilus' Attacks deal @DotDamageCalc@ magic damage over @DotDuration@ seconds to the target and surrounding enemies.
